issues.issue: Do the principal and female claimants have a well-founded fear of persecution or risk in Bangladesh (credibility included)?
issues.applicant_position: Fear of AL government targeting and police in Bangladesh; false identity used only from fear of return.
issues.respondent_position: Minister raised identity, credibility and program integrity concerns.
issues.result_quote: did not have a well-founded fear of persecution

issues.issue: Are the principal and female claimants excluded under Article 1E (permanent residence in the USA)?
issues.applicant_position: Principal claimant never had permanent resident status in the USA, so Article 1E does not apply.
issues.respondent_position: Minister submitted Article 1E and 1F(b) may affect the principal and female claimants.

issues.issue: Are the principal and female claimants excluded under Article 1F(b) for serious non-political crimes (fraudulent identity and documents)?
issues.applicant_position: Fraud was done out of fear of return to Bangladesh; section 133 protects refugee claimants from document offences.
issues.respondent_position: Minister says fraud in US and Canada is a serious non-political crime; Article 1F(b) applies.
issues.result_quote: the principal claimant and female claimant are excluded pursuant to Article 1F(b)

issues.issue: Is the minor claimant (US citizen) a person in need of protection or a refugee?
issues.result_quote: the minor claimant is not a person in need of protection
